name: India–Pakistan
value: Indus treaty in abeyance; no LoC strike
summary: India says its Indus Waters Treaty stance is unchanged as a Pakistani minister attends a 20–22 Nov SCO forum in Delhi
state: India's foreign ministry said on 21 Nov there was absolutely no change in its position on the Indus Waters Treaty, held in abeyance since April 2025, as Pakistan's climate minister attended an SCO forum in New Delhi, the first Pakistani ministerial invitation since the May 2025 hostilities (Deccan Herald). Pakistan continues to protest the suspension (The Nation, 20 Nov). No cross-border strike or mobilisation was found to 23 Nov, so Watch holds on the treaty suspension.
for_you: No change for travel; check FCDO travel advice, which advises against travel to areas near the Line of Control.
rubric_hit: Watch: treaty suspension (Indus Waters Treaty in abeyance); no cross-border strikes or mobilisation

why: Two nuclear-armed neighbours with a history of rapid escalation after terrorist attacks.
drivers: Kashmir attacks, Line of Control firing, water disputes (Indus), domestic politics.
